title: Camera control API endpoints for start, stop, retry, and listing
description: Implement api/camera_router.py with REST endpoints to list available cameras (GET /api/camera/devices), get camera status (GET /api/camera/status), start monitoring (POST /api/camera/start), stop monitoring (POST /api/camera/stop), and retry connection (POST /api/camera/retry).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/camera/devices returns array of available device indices and names
POST /api/camera/start activates capture for chosen index and returns active state
POST /api/camera/stop deactivates camera capture and frees resources
POST /api/camera/retry resets faults and re-attempts connection
Returns appropriate HTTP 400/409 error codes if camera is already active or unavailable
Unit tests verify all camera endpoints

steps.details: Create APIRouter(prefix='/api/camera', tags=['camera']) and define Pydantic request models (StartCameraRequest with camera_index, resolution).

steps.description: Implement device listing and status routes
steps.details: GET /devices calls camera_service.list_available_cameras(); GET /status returns current state, fps, resolution, active device index.

steps.description: Implement start, stop, and retry handlers
steps.details: POST /start initiates background capture; POST /stop releases capture; POST /retry calls camera_health.attempt_recovery().
Create tests/test_api_camera.py testing devices, start, stop, conflict handling, and error responses with TestClient.

technicalNotes: Prevent race conditions when multiple start calls occur rapidly.
Log camera start and stop actions via EventLogger.
